text.GUILD_RESET_TIPS: Resetting the current Skill class will cost a certain number of Gems and return spent Coins and Guild Coins. The first Reset is free.
text.GUILD_WINDOW_HELP: 1. A Guild begins at Level 1. You can level up the guild by getting Guild Exp from Guild Member daily sign-ins. Guild Exp gained from signing in cannot exceed Guild Capacity for its members.|2. The basic Member Capacity is 15. You can increase the limit by leveling up the Guild. The maximum capacity is 30.|3. Deputy Leaders are able to change the Guild Name Guild Information and Guild Icon; send Guild Mails to members; as well as manage recruitment and remove members.|4. The Guild Leader has the privileges of a Deputy Leader but they can also appoint or remove Deputy Leader titles remove Deputy Leaders from the Guild and dismiss the Guild.|5. A Guild can have at most 3 Deputy Leaders.|6. If the Guild Leader is absent for more than 7 days leadership will be automatically transferred to a deputy leader. If all the deputy leaders are also absent for more than 7 days the leadership will be automatically transferred to the player with the highest level.|7. Guild Coins will not be removed after you are removed from or quit a Guild.
text.GUILD_BOSS_WINDOW_HELP: 1. Guild members can work together and challenge Guild Bosses in Raid. |2. Earn rewards from each battle. The more powerful the Boss you challenge the better the rewards you will win. |3. After beating the Guild Boss every player will get raid rewards based on their damage ranking. (Sent via Mail). |4. Extra rewards are only given the first time you defeat a Boss. |5. If you fail to defeat the Boss you must wait 16 hours to revive and challenge the Boss again or you can spend Gems to instantly revive up to 3 times. |6. You are required to beat the Guild Boss before progressing to the next Boss. |7. You cannot challenge a Boss that is already defeated.|8.The damage dealt by servants will not be counted in damage ranking.

text.GUILD_WAR_HELP: The Playground is organized into seasons with each season lasting one week. |Each season is divided into 3 phases: the Qualifying Round Finals and Off-Season.| |Qualifying Round| 1. Time: Monday 00:00 – Friday 24:00 (GMT 0) | 2. Registration: Guild Leaders and Deputy Leaders must sign their guild up to participate in the Qualifying Round. | 3. Requirements: Guild Lv. 12 or above is required. Each Guild should send between 10-15 Teams. Each Guild Member deploys one team. | 4. Guild Leaders and Deputy Leaders can arrange battle teams. |5. Guild Leaders and Deputy Leaders can hide the info of 3 teams. |6. Guild Leaders and Deputy Leaders match-up opponents at the Playground. Leaders are allowed 10 seconds to complete the match-up. | 7. Each battle consumes 1 point of Guild Stamina which is recovered every 3 hours. | 8. Each team can battle 3 times. | 9. If the battle exceeds 15 rounds Girls remaining will increase their Attack and lower their Healing received each round until the battle is over. | 10. The winning team gains Battle Points for each victory. The Guild that wins the most battles gains Playground Points. | 11. Guilds are ranked based on their Playground Points. | 12. Rewards are sent to Mail based on their Playground Rank.| 13. Only the Guild Leader and the Deputy Leader of a Guild can see the actual order of the Guild members in Playground.| Finals| 1. The top 16 Guilds in the Qualifying Round automatically enter the Finals. The system matches up qualified Guilds with opponents based on their ranking. | 2. Preparation time: Saturday 00:00 to 16:00; Competition time: Saturday 16:00 to 18:00. | 3. Special frames will be removed when a new season begins. | 4. At the end of the competition rewards will be sent to Mail based on rank. | 5. Final Ranking Rewards: | Rank 1: 8000 Guild coins 3000000 Coins| Rank 2: 6000 Guild coins 2000000 Coins| Rank 3-4: 4000 Guild coins 1500000 Coins| Rank 5-8: 3000 Guild coins 1000000 Coins| Rank 9-16: 2000 Guild coins 500000 Coins. | Off-Season| 1. In the Off-Season players can check the battle records from the Finals. | Attention: If players leave their Guild during the Playground season they will not receive rewards and participate until the next Playground season.

text.GUILD_COMPETITION_HELP:
Join forces with Guild members to defeat powerful enemies in Sky Island.|Member Restrictions:|When Sky Island begins players cannot quit Guild remove a Guild member or disband Guild. Joining or creating a Guild is unaffected.|Score Rule|Each enemy can provide 100K Points in total you will win their points according to the damage you deal. Points will be calculated based on the HP percentage of the enemy that was lowered in the Real Battle.|Challenge Chances:|1. Each Guild member has a maximum of 3 Challenges per day.
2. Each enemy can be challenged up to 30 times per day.|Real Battle vs Demo Battle|1. There are two battle modes that can be selected when battling enemies Real Battle and Demo Battle.
2. Real Battle: Consumes Challenges to battle; rewards and points can be earned when the battle ends.
3. Demo Battle: No Challenges are consumed for this training battle and no rewards or points can be earned in this mode. Demo Battle is still available even when Challenge chances have reached 0. When Demo Battle begins the HP of enemies in this mode is the actual amount of HP the enemy has left in Real Battle.|Rewards:|1. Battle Rewards: Rewards can be obtained after each battle.
2. Boss Defeat Rewards: Guild Members who participated in defeating the enemy will receive rewards when the enemy is defeated.
3. Damage Rank Rewards: Guild members will be ranked according to points obtained from attacking enemies. The ranking of points obtained from enemies with different names will be calculated separately (e.g. the points you obtained by attacking one enemy from Lv1 to the highest level you reach will be calculated in a separate ranking list from the other 2 ranking lists made for the other 2 enemies). The Damage Rank Rewards will be sent via Mail after Sky Island ends.
  When there are less than 10 participants of Sky Island in a Guild the Damage Rank Rewards obtained will be lowered by 10%% for each participant missing. The Damage Rank Rewards will be lowered for at most 90%%.
4. Guild Rank Rewards: Guilds will be ranked according to the total points earned from Real Battle. Once Sky Island ends rewards according to rank will be sent to Guild members with more than 0 points. Frames will be added directly to the players’ accounts and other rewards will still need to be claimed via Mail. (If players quit a Guild are removed from their Guild or the Guild is disbanded rewards can still be obtained)

text.GUILD_NEW_WAR_HELP01: [c][699be9]Registration Requirements[-][/c]|1. Your Guild must have at least reached Lv. 12 and have over 5 active members in the past week.|2. A Guild that meets the requirements will automatically be registered for the current season of Guild Championship once any Guild member enters the Guild Championship event page.|[c][699be9]Rules[-][/c]|1. Guild Championship will be divided into seasons. There will be 8 competitions between 2 Guilds in each season;|2. Each competition between 2 Guilds will last for 3 days (1 day of preparation and 2 days of battle period); Each Guild will start with 1 Main Base 3 Center Bases and 2 Front Bases. Your Guild will need to prevent the Bases from being destroyed by protecting the Flags inside the Bases.|3. Each season is separated into 3 different periods: Break Period Preparation Period and Battle Period. The first 3 days and the last 4 days of each season are Break Periods. The details during the season are as follow: |Monday: Break Period you can check the Guild details and battle record of the season during this period.|Tuesday: Preparation Period you can adjust your Guild defense during this period.|Wednesday & Thursday: Battle Period your Guild will compete with another Guild in a Battle Period.|Friday: Preparation Period you can adjust your Guild defense during this period.|Saturday & Sunday: Battle Period your Guild will compete with another Guild in a Battle Period.|4. The system will automatically assign Guild Members to defend the Flags in the bases according to their Power. The players with higher Power will be assigned to the Bases with higher priority (Base Priority: Main Base > Center Base > Front Base). Guild Members can adjust their own defense lineups. Guild Leaders and Deputy Leaders can also adjust the position of all Guild Members manually (your defense lineup will be updated after saving your defense lineup).|5. During the Battle Period you can attack the Flags in enemy Bases if there's a player guarding a Flag you will need to defeat the player (by reducing the player's Moral to 0) before attacking the Flag; After all Flags in a Base are removed the Base will be destroyed; You will need to destroy at least 1 Front Base before attacking a Center Base; You need to destroy at least 1 Center Base before attacking the Main Base; After all enemy Bases are destroyed you will be able to consume your remaining Challenge Chances to Clean Up the field and get additional rewards including Guild Points and Personal Contribution.|6. After a Battle Period ends the Guild that wins more Guild Points during the Battle Period will win. If the 2 Guilds win the same number of Guild Points the Guild that has higher Power will win.|[c][699be9]Matching & Ranking[-][/c]|1. A Guild will gain basic Guild Points at the beginning of each season according to its ranking in the last season. For Guilds that enter the competition for the first time the basic Guild Points of a Guild when it first enters the competition will be concluded according to the total Power of its Guild Members.|2. The position of Guilds in the Guild Ranking will be sorted according to their current Guild Points. If 2 Guilds have the same number of Guild Points the Guild that reaches the number of Guild Points first will take the higher position in the list.|3. The opponent will be another Guild with the number of Guild Points close to the Guild.|[c][699be9]Guild Points[-][/c]|1. Your Guild will get 100/150/300 Guild Points for removing a Flag in the Front Base/Center Base/Main Base.|2. Your Guild will get 500/1000/2000 Guild Points for destroying the enemy Front Base/Center Base/Main Base.|3. Your Guild will get 2000/1000 for winning/losing in a competition.|4. Your Guild will get 10 Guild Points every time a Guild Member Cleans Up the field.|[c][699be9]Personal Contribution[-][/c]|1. When attacking a defender the system will conduct 3 battles with the 6 (3+3) lineups you and your opponent set. The battle can be considered a "Best of Three". The player who wins 2 battles is the winner. You can get 15 points of Personal Contribution for losing the battle and 20 points of Personal Contribution for winning the battle;|2. You can get 15 points of Personal Contribution for attacking a Flag.|3. You can get 5 points of Personal Contribution every time you Clean Up the field.|[c][699be9]Reward[-][/c]|1. Guild Battle Reward will be issued to Guild Members who have earned at least 1 point of Personal Contribution in the competition and have participated in the Base defense at the end of each competition.|2. Personal Battle Reward will be issued to Guild Members who have earned at least 1 point of Personal Contribution in the competition at the end of each competition.|3. Guild Championship Reward will be issued to Guild Members who have earned at least 1 point of Personal Contribution and have participated in the Base defense in the competition at the end of each competition. The reward will be different according to the position of your Guild in the Ranking list.|4. You can get an additional reward each time you attack a defender attack a Flag or Clean Up the field.

text.GUILD_NEW_WAR_HELP02: 1. There are multiple Flags set in each base your Guild controls. You can assign 1 Guild Member as the protector of each Flag. Each defender has 200 Moral when assigned.|2. When attacking a defender the system will conduct 3 battles with the 6 (3+3) lineups you and your opponent set. You will at least reduce the Moral of the defender by 5 for each attack. The Moral reduction will increase by 5 for each victory in the 3 battles.|3. The defender will be defeated after the Moral is reduced to 0. You will then be able to attack the unguarded Flag. You can reduce the Durability of the Flag for each attack in this situation. After a Flag loses all its Durability it will be removed.|4. After all Flags in a Base are removed the Base will be destroyed; After all enemy Bases are destroyed you will be able to consume your remaining Challenge Chances to Clean Up the field and get additional rewards.|5. During the battle period you can get 10 Challenge chances for your first time entering the event each day. To challenge enemies attack the Flags and Clean Up the field one chance will be consumed and the corresponding rewards can be received after.|6. All your Girls in your attack lineup will gain 10%% extra Attack 20%% extra HP and 10%% extra Damage Depletion for every Center Base your Guild destroys in this competition; After destroying the Main Base of the opposing Guild the Attacking Guild will gain 50 extra Guild Points whenever it gains Guild Points in this competition.|7. Guild Leaders and Deputy Leaders can mark one of the enemy Base as a target to focus attack on. When attacking the target all damage dealt by the Girls on the Attacking Team will be increased by 10%%. Focus attack targets can be re-selected 12 hours after the last focus attack target is selected.
